verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer is a law firm, but it ships its own software: the homegrown ChatGD app, the D&O Questionnaire Portal, the Contract Generator, GDHQ and Catalyze. Whether that source is openly licensed is therefore a fair question. Nothing in the evidence shows any of these tools' source being published under an open license. The only open-source mention is legal advisory work for clients, not the firm's own code.
